title: RDA Coverage Record
description: Every skill declares what it actually looked at. A finding without a coverage record is an anecdote. A silence without a coverage record is a lie by omission.

definition.description: e.g. 'all HTTP route declarations across 41 services'

count.description: Denominator, produced by RDA-02 census, not estimated.

source.description: Deterministic command that produced the denominator.

selection.description: CONVENIENCE sampling caps any derived finding at C1 and must be disclosed in the executive summary.

seed.description: Required for STRATIFIED_RANDOM so the sample is reproducible.

method.description: How inspection was performed: deterministic tool, AST query, grep+range read, full read.

impact.description: What conclusions cannot be drawn because of this gap.

expiry.description: Commit SHA at which this coverage record becomes stale.
